origin:
The Mercedes-AMG amateur racing team was born not on a boardroom table, but in a dimly lit autobody shop just outside Affalterbach. Conceived by a group of passionate AMG engineers who spent their weekends tinkering with salvaged race cars, the team's initial ambition was simply to prove that the spirit of AMG could extend beyond the factory walls and into the grassroots racing scene. Their first car, a heavily modified C-Class sedan affectionately nicknamed 'The Hammerhead', was built using spare parts and sheer determination. Initial races were a comedy of errors, but the team's relentless pursuit of performance and the visible AMG backing garnered attention.

Over time, the amateur team’s efforts caught the attention of senior management at Mercedes-AMG. While not officially integrated, the factory provides significant logistical and technical support, turning the team into something of a skunkworks project. The team still operates with the heart of an amateur endeavor, retaining its original members and continuing to prioritize hands-on development and driver skill above all else. Key moments included a surprise podium finish at the Nürburgring Langstrecken Serie (NLS) in 2022 and several class wins in regional German touring car championships.
philosophy: The team's philosophy centers around the pursuit of accessible racing excellence. They believe in maximizing the potential of readily available technology and nurturing raw talent. Car development is a collaborative process, relying heavily on driver feedback and data analysis. The team culture emphasizes camaraderie, continuous learning, and a relentless drive to improve, even with the backing of a major manufacturer.
achievements: Podium finish at the Nürburgring Langstrecken Serie (NLS) in 2022
Multiple class wins in regional German touring car championships
Consistent top-10 finishes in various amateur racing events
Successful development and integration of new technologies into race cars

teamPrincipal.name: Klaus Hoffmann
teamPrincipal.background: Klaus Hoffmann is a former AMG engineer and one of the founding members of the team. Known for his calm demeanor and sharp tactical mind, he fosters a collaborative and supportive environment, empowering team members to take ownership of their roles.

keyFigures.name: Lena Schmidt
keyFigures.description: Lena Schmidt is a brilliant engineer with a knack for finding innovative solutions to complex problems. Her expertise in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics has been instrumental in the team's success.

keyFigures.name: Marco Rossi
keyFigures.description: Marco Rossi is a talented driver with a natural feel for the car and exceptional racecraft. He provides invaluable feedback during testing and consistently delivers strong performances on race day.

headquarters: The team operates out of a modest workshop located near the Mercedes-AMG factory in Affalterbach. While basic, the facilities are equipped with essential tools and equipment, including a dyno and a small fabrication area.
fanBase: The team enjoys a loyal following among local motorsport enthusiasts and AMG aficionados. Their down-to-earth approach and underdog spirit resonate with fans who appreciate genuine passion and dedication.
